title: The 49ers should keep a close eye on Minkah Fitzpatrick this offseason

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: The 49ers should keep a close eye on Minkah Fitzpatrick this offseason
sources.description: The Dolphins had a fire sale earlier in the week. If they make Minkah Fitzpatrick available, the 49ers should think long and hard about acquiring him.
